# Terminology and expert-review ledger

This ledger accompanies the Marathi OpenLogic translation at frozen upstream revision `9620cc73f9c8e0ad003c514a5d3748f29611c4c0`. It is maintained for specialist review and correction; review is welcome but is not a completion or publication gate.

The current editable-source coverage is **233/722 units** (OLP-0004–OLP-0236, 2333 aligned translated content blocks). The current public reader is the 194/722-unit `twenty-chapters-v0.9` checkpoint. Decisions without an applied location are pre-adjudications for later units. This is partial coverage and makes no full-corpus claim.

For T001–T044, the rationale provenance is explicitly a **retrospective reconstruction** from the durable decision records and current aligned files. It is not represented as an original contemporaneous motive. T045 onward were recorded with their first current use. Aligned block scopes are contextual locations governed by a unit-level decision index. Where a segment supplies `choice_line_spans`, the occurrence surfaces use the narrower decision-relevant source and target lines; these choice spans may overlap and do not claim a disjoint token partition. Literal line hits remain separate supporting diagnostics.

Authorities below are only those actually consulted. A missing authority is stated as not checked/not found; no evidence is inferred from an unavailable dictionary or expert. The frozen English mathematics governs theorem meaning. All provisional choices remain open to correction.

Occurrence-level review surfaces add exact source/target lines and the current coherent-reader page range: [readable full occurrence index](EXPERT_REVIEW_OCCURRENCES.md), [priority view](EXPERT_REVIEW_PRIORITY.md), [one-row-per-occurrence CSV](EXPERT_REVIEW_OCCURRENCES.csv), and [machine JSONL](EXPERT_REVIEW_OCCURRENCES.jsonl).

The current public DOI record `10.5281/zenodo.22864626` predates this development ledger. The next substantive, nonduplicative release will include it under the existing concept DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22307960`; no ledger-only release is created.

## T009 — formal validity

- **Chosen wording:** वैधता
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** retrospective reconstruction from durable decision record and aligned files.
- **Status/uncertainty:** adopted-primary-textbook. This choice remains open to correction.
- **Rationale:** Preserved Marathi logic textbook explicitly distinguishes argument वैधता from truth of statements; युक्तता and आकारिक प्रामाण्य recorded as attested alternatives. Adopt वैधता consistently in formal truth-preservation sense, not legal legitimacy; keep soundness separate.
- **Alternatives considered:** युक्तता; आकारिक प्रामाण्य.

## T034 — symmetric / anti-symmetric / asymmetric

- **Chosen wording:** सममित / प्रतिसममित / असममित
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** retrospective reconstruction from durable decision record and aligned files.
- **Status/uncertainty:** evidence-based-provisional; attestation limits in reason. This choice remains open to correction.
- **Rationale:** Compositional technical distinctions, definitions governed by source. Anti-symmetry permits a two-way relation only at equality; asymmetry forbids every two-way pair. Not-symmetric kept as सममित नसलेला, not used as synonym for either.

## T108 — propositional logic

- **Chosen wording:** विधानीय तर्कशास्त्र
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** adopted direct native logic attestation; open to correction. This choice remains open to correction.
- **Rationale:** A Marathi university syllabus directly uses विधानीय तर्कशास्त्र, and the checked predicate-logic text contrasts it with विधेय तर्कशास्त्र. The rendering therefore preserves the logic-of-whole-propositions sense without importing first-order internal structure.

## T109 — proof system / proof

- **Chosen wording:** सिद्धता-पद्धती / सिद्धता
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** provisional compound supported by direct native proof terminology; open to correction. This choice remains open to correction.

## T111 — valuation (propositional semantics)

- **Chosen wording:** सत्य-मूल्यांकन
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** provisional descriptive logic term; expert review especially useful. This choice remains open to correction.
- **Rationale:** The source object assigns truth values to propositional variables. MR-P081 directly supports मूल्यन and मूल्यांकन, while MR-P066 attests सत्यतामूल्य. सत्य-मूल्यांकन composes these to disambiguate the logical object from economic valuation.

## T112 — predicate / term / quantifier

- **Chosen wording:** विधेय / पद / संख्यापक
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** adopted from direct and closely adjacent native logic usage; open to correction. This choice remains open to correction.
- **Rationale:** The checked university and logic-book pages directly distinguish विधेय logic and संख्यापक, and discuss the internal पद structure of statements. The coordinated list is used when explaining which first-order features disappear in the propositional fragment.

## T122 — tautology

- **Chosen wording:** सर्वतः सत्य सूत्र
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** adopted primary-textbook explanatory term; official alternative logged; expert review useful. This choice remains open to correction.

## T123 — entailment / entails

- **Chosen wording:** तार्किक निष्पन्नता / तार्किकरीत्या निष्पन्न होणे
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** provisional definition-controlled term with attested alternative; expert review especially useful. This choice remains open to correction.
- **Rationale:** OpenLogic's all-valuations clause directly fixes model-theoretic consequence. तार्किक निष्पन्नता states that relation without suggesting a performed inference; MR-P070's explicitly logical अनिवार्य अनुमान remains an attested alternative.

## T127 — propositional constant

- **Chosen wording:** विधानीय स्थिर
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** provisional harmonization of direct adjacent attestations; expert review useful. This choice remains open to correction.
- **Rationale:** The preserved university usage controls विधानीय, while MR-P068 directly attests the related compounds वैधानिक स्थिर and आदिम चिन्ह. स्थिर distinguishes the nullary logical symbol from a variable.
- **Alternatives considered:** वैधानिक स्थिर; विधान-स्थिर; विधानीय अचल.

- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.

## T152 — natural deduction / sequent calculus

- **Chosen wording:** नैसर्गिक निगमन / क्रमवर्ती कलन
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** adopted direct authoritative Marathi proof-theory usage. This choice remains open to correction.
- **Rationale:** The Marathi Vishwakosh proof-theory article directly names both calculi and attributes their development to Jaśkowski and Gentzen.

## T155 — soundness / sound / unsound (of a proof system)

- **Chosen wording:** निर्दोषता / निर्दोष / सदोष
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** not-attested-in-proof-theory; definition-controlled provisional choice; high-priority expert review useful. This choice remains open to correction.
- **Rationale:** The official glossary lists निर्दोषता and दृढता only in a metallurgy domain; it does not attest proof-system soundness. The target chooses निर्दोषता provisionally because OpenLogic defines the property as permitting derivation only of what semantically follows: valid sequents in the sequent-calculus presentation, and sentences from undischarged assumptions from which they follow in natural deduction. This keeps the system property separate from वैधता. MR-P009 and MR-P010 support adjacent syntax/semantics and validity vocabulary, not the disputed headword.
- **Alternatives considered:** दृढता / दृढ / अदृढ; सुदृढता / सुदृढ / असुदृढ; प्रामाण्य / प्रमाण / अप्रमाण.

## T156 — consistency / inconsistency / consistent / inconsistent

- **Chosen wording:** सुसंगतता / विसंगतता / सुसंगत / विसंगत
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.

## T160 — introduction rule / elimination rule

- **Chosen wording:** प्रवेशन नियम / विलोपन नियम
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** provisional transparent rule pair; exact Marathi natural-deduction attestation not found; expert review especially useful. This choice remains open to correction.

## T165 — signed formula / truth-value sign / immediate subformula

- **Chosen wording:** चिन्हांकित सूत्र / सत्यतामूल्याचे चिन्ह / तात्काळ उपसूत्र
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** signed and sign stems directly attested; full compounds and immediate-subformula label compositional and provisional. This choice remains open to correction.
- **Rationale:** MR-P086 directly establishes चिन्हांकित संख्या, चिन्हांकित मान and चिन्ह, while existing decisions establish सूत्र and सत्यतामूल्य. चिन्हांकित सूत्र and सत्यतामूल्याचे चिन्ह are therefore evidence-backed compositions. तात्काळ उपसूत्र is definition-controlled by the source rule that replaces a complex signed formula with its immediate constituent formulas.

## T175 — weakening / contraction / exchange / cut (sequent-calculus structural rules)

- **Chosen wording:** दुर्बलीकरण / आकुंचन / अदलाबदल / कट
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** contraction generally attested; other labels definition-controlled and provisional; all four expert-reviewable. This choice remains open to correction.
- **Rationale:** The university and Vishwakosh sources establish inference-rule and sequent-calculus vocabulary. MR-P097 directly lists आकुंचन for contraction. MR-P096 gives the adjacent logic term विपर्यय for commutation, but the frozen A,B to B,A diagrams make the ordinary अदलाबदल clearer for exchange. No checked official source attested the exact proof-theory labels for weakening, exchange or cut. दुर्बलीकरण is a reversible process noun, and कट retains the recognizable formal label while avoiding छेद, already used for set intersection and Dedekind cuts. Every local sense is fixed by its displayed rule.
- **Alternatives considered:** शिथिलीकरण / संकुचन / विपर्यय / छेद; दुर्बलन / संकोचन / विनिमय / कर्तन; क्षीणीकरण / आकुंचन / स्थानबदल / कट नियम.

## T176 — end-sequent

- **Chosen wording:** अंतिम क्रमवर्ती
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** definition-controlled and provisional; expert-reviewable. This choice remains open to correction.

- **Chosen wording:** बद्ध चर
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.

## T205 — variable / constant / function (as language symbols)

- **Chosen wording:** चर / स्थिर / फलन
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** direct variable and function evidence with source-controlled constant sense; expert-reviewable. This choice remains open to correction.
- **Rationale:** MR-P007 directly attests variable vocabulary, MR-P029 and MR-P030 establish फलन in mathematical use, and MR-P068 establishes the formal-symbol register. ## T209 — denumerable / countably infinite

- **Chosen wording:** गणनीय अनंत
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.

## T210 — truth-functionally complete / expressively complete

- **Chosen wording:** सत्यता-फलनात्मकदृष्ट्या संपूर्ण / अभिव्यक्तीदृष्ट्या संपूर्ण

## T250 — full / weak second-order semantics; full structure

- **Chosen wording:** पूर्ण / दुर्बल द्वितीय-क्रम चिन्हार्थमीमांसा; पूर्ण रचना

- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.

## T281 — standard / non-standard model, element or number

- **Chosen wording:** मानक / अमानक प्रतिमान, घटक किंवा संख्या
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** source-defined extension of established standard, model and number terminology; exact compounds unattested; expert-reviewable. This choice remains open to correction.
- **Rationale:** The edition already uses मानक for the standard formal language, प्रतिमान for model and संख्या for number. OpenLogic defines the present contrast extensionally: standard models are isomorphic to N; their elements, here called standard numbers, are exactly standard-numeral values; and a non-standard model or number lies outside the corresponding isomorphism or value condition. अमानक is the transparent negative and does not imply merely defective or irregular.

## T299 — Compactness Property / Downward Löwenheim--Skolem Property

- **Chosen wording:** संहतता गुणधर्म / अधोगामी लोव्हेनहाइम--स्कोलेम गुणधर्म
- **Coverage:** applied in current partial source coverage.
- **Decision provenance:** contemporaneous durable decision at first current use.
- **Status/uncertainty:** established theorem components under explicit abstract-logic definitions; downward modifier unattested; expert-reviewable. This choice remains open to correction.
- **Rationale:** The edition already uses संहतता and लोव्हेनहाइम--स्कोलेम प्रमेय. OpenLogic extends them explicitly to abstract logics: every finitely satisfiable sentence set is satisfiable, and every satisfiable sentence set has an enumerable model. अधोगामी preserves the direction toward a smaller model without adding a cardinality claim beyond the displayed enumerable clause.
- **Alternatives considered:** संहतता धर्म / निम्नगामी लोव्हेनहाइम--स्कोलेम धर्म; कॉम्पॅक्टनेस गुणधर्म / डाउनवर्ड लोव्हेनहाइम--स्कोलेम गुणधर्म; अवरोही लोव्हेनहाइम--स्कोलेम गुणधर्म.
